\section[(dialogue)]{The house, clothes and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R129-first-pass-the-house-clothes-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for apples and dates.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item jam, a pomegranate, strawberries, lettuce, an aubergine
  \item a cabbage, mint, parsley, thyme, cumin
  \item a cupboard, a comb, soap, a towel, a mattress
  \item a blanket, a pillow, a ladder, a stove, a vessel
  \item scissors, a needle, a thread, a button, a nail
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Jam? (\textbf{\ar{مربى}}, \emph{murabbā}.) A pomegranate? (\textbf{\ar{رمان}}, \emph{rummān}.) Strawberries? (\textbf{\ar{فراولة}}, \emph{farāwila}.) Lettuce? (\textbf{\ar{خس}}, \emph{khass}.) An aubergine? (\textbf{\ar{باذنجان}}, \emph{bādhinjān}.) A cabbage? (\textbf{\ar{ملفوف}}, \emph{malfūf}.) Mint? (\textbf{\ar{نعناع}}, \emph{naʿnāʿ}.) Parsley? (\textbf{\ar{بقدونس}}, \emph{baqdūnis}.) Thyme? (\textbf{\ar{زعتر}}, \emph{zaʿtar}.) Cumin? (\textbf{\ar{كمون}}, \emph{kammūn}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{\ar{خزانة}}, \emph{khizāna}.) A comb? (\textbf{\ar{مشط}}, \emph{mushṭ}.) Soap? (\textbf{\ar{صابون}}, \emph{ṣābūn}.) A towel? (\textbf{\ar{منشفة}}, \emph{minshafa}.) A mattress? (\textbf{\ar{فراش}}, \emph{firāsh}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\ar{بطانية}}, \emph{baṭṭāniyya}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\ar{وسادة}}, \emph{wisāda}.) A ladder? (\textbf{\ar{سلم}}, \emph{sullam}.) A stove? (\textbf{\ar{موقد}}, \emph{mawqid}.) A vessel? (\textbf{\ar{إناء}}, \emph{ināʾ}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\ar{مقص}}, \emph{miqaṣṣ}.) A needle? (\textbf{\ar{إبرة}}, \emph{ibra}.) A thread? (\textbf{\ar{خيط}}, \emph{khayṭ}.) A button? (\textbf{\ar{زر}}, \emph{zirr}.) A nail? (\textbf{\ar{مسمار}}, \emph{mismār}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Food and the kitchen — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R129-second-pass-food-and-the-kitchen}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bucket and a broom.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a bucket, a broom, rubbish, a basket, a box
  \item a candle, a carpet, a doll, a toy, a fridge
  \item a curtain, a lock, a handkerchief, a bracelet, an earring
  \item glasses, pepper, wheat, lentils, chickpeas
  \item beans, garlic, a cucumber, apples, dates
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A bucket? (\textbf{\ar{دلو}}, \emph{dalw}.) A broom? (\textbf{\ar{مكنسة}}, \emph{miknasa}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{\ar{قمامة}}, \emph{qumāma}.) A basket? (\textbf{\ar{سلة}}, \emph{salla}.) A box? (\textbf{\ar{صندوق}}, \emph{ṣundūq}.) A candle? (\textbf{\ar{شمعة}}, \emph{shamʿa}.) A carpet? (\textbf{\ar{سجادة}}, \emph{sajjāda}.) A doll? (\textbf{\ar{دمية}}, \emph{dumya}.) A toy? (\textbf{\ar{لعبة}}, \emph{luʿba}.) A fridge? (\textbf{\ar{ثلاجة}}, \emph{thallāja}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\ar{ستارة}}, \emph{sitāra}.) A lock? (\textbf{\ar{قفل}}, \emph{qifl}.) A handkerchief? (\textbf{\ar{منديل}}, \emph{mindīl}.) A bracelet? (\textbf{\ar{سوار}}, \emph{siwār}.) An earring? (\textbf{\ar{قرط}}, \emph{qurṭ}.) Glasses? (\textbf{\ar{نظارة}}, \emph{naẓẓāra}.) Pepper? (\textbf{\ar{فلفل}}, \emph{filfil}.) Wheat? (\textbf{\ar{قمح}}, \emph{qamḥ}.) Lentils? (\textbf{\ar{عدس}}, \emph{ʿadas}.) Chickpeas? (\textbf{\ar{حمص}}, \emph{ḥummuṣ}.) Beans? (\textbf{\ar{فول}}, \emph{fūl}.) Garlic? (\textbf{\ar{ثوم}}, \emph{thūm}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{\ar{خيار}}, \emph{khiyār}.) Apples? (\textbf{\ar{تفاح}}, \emph{tuffāḥ}.) Dates? (\textbf{\ar{تمر}}, \emph{tamr}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
